title: 推し活全開！PayPayドーム女子観戦あるある3連発
scene: PayPayドームの観客席で、ユニフォーム姿の20代女性2人が笑顔でタオルを掲げて応援。推し選手のうちわを手に盛り上がるショット。グルメ片手に自撮りしながら乾杯するシーン。
caption: PayPayドームの観客席に集まる、野球女子たちのリアルな推し活シーンを3連発で！ユニフォームに着替えて、推しのタオルやうちわを全力で振るこの時間が、実は一番のリフレッシュだったり🤍野球仲間と「今日のグルメ何食べる？」って言いながら盛り上がる瞬間も最高なんだよね🍽️1人観戦が寂しいって思ったこともあったけど、勇気出して新しい仲間に話しかけてみたら世界広がったりするし、ほんと推し活って出会いのきっかけだと思う🥰野球観戦の楽しみ方って無限大！あなたはどれに共感しましたか？

prompts.kling: A vertical 9:16, 10-15 second photorealistic video shot with a natural smartphone feel inside PayPay Dome in Fukuoka. Two Japanese women in their 20s, wearing trendy baseball uniforms, are in the stands: first they cheer smiling with towels held up overhead, then excitedly wave handmade fans with their favorite player's name, finally laugh while clinking drinks (like lemonade or beer) and taking a selfie together with stadium food in hand. Natural handheld camera with casual movement, warm lighting, no overlays, no AI vibes.
prompts.veo: Vertical 9:16, photorealistic, smartphone-shot look. 0-5s: Two Japanese women in their 20s in baseball uniforms, in PayPay Dome stands, standing together smiling, waving towels in support for their favorite team. 5-10s: The friends sit down together, holding and shaking custom fans with their baseball hero’s name, showing enthusiastic and fun expressions. 10-15s: Both toast their drinks and take a cheerful selfie, holding classic Japanese stadium food, with the outfield as colorful background. All handheld, natural body language, lively stadium atmosphere, no text overlays.
